opennyai_summary.18_September_2023__facts:
The petitioner has prayed for regular bail in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 420, 376, 504, 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the Prevention of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.
about 20 years according to the FIR
The petitioner has got no criminal antecedent as stated in para-3 of the bail petition.
opennyai_summary.18_September_2023__arguments:
From perusal of FIR, it seems there is consensual relationship between the petitioner and the victim.
Admittedly, their relation was converted into marriage which was registered by the Marriage Officer, West Champaran at Bettiah.
Subsequently, the victim went to her paternal home, where she developed illicit relation with someone other, and was not ready to lead conjugal life with the petitioner thereafter, the petitioner filed Matrimonial Case No. 346 of 2022 for restitution of conjugal right u/s 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act.
